title: RES.18-011 Algebra I Student Notes
authors: Students of the Fall 2021 on-campus 18.701 Algebra I class (unnamed on OCW)
description: Typed notes taken by students in a Fall 2021 on-campus 18.701 Algebra I class, published by OCW as a supplement to the Fall 2010 18.701 course. Thirty-five lectures: groups, subgroups and cyclic groups, homomorphisms, cosets, the correspondence theorem, quotient groups, vector spaces and Jordan form, isometries and symmetry groups, group actions and the class equation, the icosahedral group, conjugacy in S_n and A_n, the Sylow theorems, bilinear forms, the spectral theorem, linear groups, SU(2), one-parameter subgroups, Lie groups, simple linear groups and Hilbert's third problem.
rightsNotes: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (MIT OpenCourseWare); attribution and share-alike required, no commercial use.

OCW states the notes 'have not been checked for accuracy by the instructors of that class or by other MIT faculty members'. Corniversity cites them as a supplement only and re-derives every result it teaches.
